text: Coffee with Aidan this morning. He's got a second interview at the council on Thursday at 2pm and is properly nervous about it. His girlfriend Mei is apparently flat hunting in Leeds already, just in case. Text him good luck Wednesday night. Also he wants to come to the gig on the 9th, check if there's a spare ticket.
Matilda and Juan's housewarming is Saturday at 7. They finally got the keys to the place on Elm Road. I'm bringing a lasagne, she said Juan's vegetarian now.

Long catch up with Adriana. She's moving to Lisbon on June 3rd, flights booked, landlord sorted. Her mum isn't thrilled about it. She wants a decent coffee grinder for the new flat, gift idea. Her leaving do is May 30 from 6, somewhere in Shoreditch, details to follow. Her brother Louis is driving the van down with her stuff.
Marcus called. Dinner at his on the 12th at half 9 is off, Rosa's working nights that week. Said we'd do something in November instead.
Mia had her interview at the bank yesterday afternoon. Thinks it went ok but they asked loads of maths questions. Should hear by Friday. Ask her how it went on the weekend.
Vera says Ethan got the flat! The one in Hackney with the tiny balcony. Moves in 11/2. She's helping with the van that morning.

Zainab - applying for the head of marketing role at her place, deadline is October 31 at noon. Her boss told her to go for it. Doesn't believe she'll get it. Need to check in with her after she submits.
Agnieszka mentioned her brother Karan is coming over from Krakow for a few weeks in December. He's looking at jobs in London. Big football fan, Arsenal.
Pick up boxes from the post office tomorrow morning before 10. Then the viewing on Crane St at 1:30.
Archie's 40th is Friday at 8pm at the Crown, back room. Patrick is organising, everyone chipping in for a watch. Don't forget to send Patrick twenty quid.
Aneesh and his wife are expecting! Due in April. They're also trying to sell the flat before then, which sounds stressful. He seemed knackered honestly.

Louis has an interview with a design studio in Bristol next Tuesday at 11. If he gets it they'd relocate in the new year. His partner Yasmin is a teacher, would have to find a new school. Wish him luck Monday.
Rosa's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, went fine. She's off work till Wednesday looking after him.
Rang Juan back. He's been rejected from three places this month and is pretty down about it. Offered to look over his CV. Do that this weekend, and invite him for a pint.
Karan Reyes - met at Kenji's party. Works in logistics, just moved to Manchester from Leicester. Into climbing. Lives near Ancoats.
Kenji's leaving drinks are May 14 at 6pm, he's off to Osaka for a new job. His sister Mei is flying over for it. Remind me to get a card everyone can sign.

Rory says the flat viewing he went to on Saturday was a disaster, damp everywhere. He's got another one Thursday evening. Mustafa might move in with him if it works out. Mustafa's lease ends 11/15 so they're cutting it fine. Rory reckons letting agents in this city are all crooks.
Kiara invited me to her engagement party, 7/19, at her parents' place in Kent. Starts at 4. Need to RSVP by Friday and sort a train.
Ann and her husband have bought a house in Norwich! Completion is the 28th. She's planning a big housewarming once they're settled, probably early December.
Marisol is so nervous about her driving test on Monday at 8:40am. Third attempt. Her dad's taking her for a practice drive Sunday. Text her that morning.

Bridget's back from Toronto. She's thinking of moving there properly, has applied for two jobs at hospitals out there. Interview over video on the 6th at 3pm our time. Her flatmate Yasmin doesn't know yet. She also said her nan's 85th is the weekend after and the whole family's going to Galway for it.
Carlos Gonzalez, Bridget's new boyfriend. Chef at a tapas place in Brixton. Allergic to shellfish, which he said is ironic. Nice guy.
Mohammed and Karim are doing a joint 30th on Saturday 15th, dinner at 7:30 then out. I'm driving so not drinking. Already got Mohammed's present sorted.

Lwazi's mum is in hospital again. He's going up to Birmingham tomorrow morning and won't be at the interview he had lined up for Wednesday, had to cancel it. I should call him Thursday to see how she's doing.
Bao starts at the architecture firm on June 2nd. She was so happy. Moving to a flat share in Peckham the weekend before.

Catch up with Aidan and Matilda over brunch. Aidan's still job hunting, two applications in this week, one at a charity he's really keen on. Matilda's moving out of the shared house on the 30th and into her own studio. She's been saving for ages. Her cat Pickle is coming too obviously. They're both coming to mine for dinner Friday at 7.
Adriana told me Marcus didn't get the job at the agency. He hasn't said anything to me so play it cool. Maybe take him out for lunch next week.
Vera's thinking about moving back to Glasgow. Misses her family, rent's killing her here. Not decided. She works remotely so it's possible.
Ethan - housewarming Sat 11/8 from 2pm, bring a bottle. His flatmate Zainab is doing a barbecue. Ethan wants a decent toolkit for the new place, been dropping hints all week.
Agnieszka's PhD viva is the 22nd at 10am. She's been a wreck about it. Her partner Mei says she's barely sleeping. Send her something nice the day before.

Lunch with Archie. He's applied for a transfer to the Edinburgh office, interview is 9/3. His wife Rosa is from there so they're keen. Kids would change schools in January if it happens. Ask him how it went next week.
Patrick is hosting Thanksgiving again, November 26 at 5. Said bring dessert. He's also got a new puppy called Ziggy, a beagle.
Need to email the letting agent about the deposit, and book the van for the 14th at 8am.

Aneesh Nguyen, new neighbour in 4B. Software engineer, works from home. Has two kids, the eldest started secondary this year. Asked if I want to do a street party in spring. His wife Marisol runs the residents' group apparently. Their dog Pepper is the one that barks at 6am.
Louis's grandad's 90th is this Sunday lunchtime, whole family going to a pub in Devon. Louis is driving down Saturday.

Yasmin's mum is moving in with them next month after her fall. Yasmin's trying to juggle that and a promotion interview on Friday at 4. Sounds like a lot. Her husband Kenji is doing nights so she's basically alone with it all. Check in with her over the weekend, maybe drop round some food on Sunday afternoon.
Juan said the dinner party at Rosa's is still on for tomorrow night at 8, just moved to her new place. Bring wine, she's not drinking though, she's pregnant.
Karan got into the grad scheme at Deloitte! Starts September 7. Moving to London in August, staying with his uncle in Croydon until he finds somewhere. Send congrats.
Kenji and Mei have pulled out of the house in Didsbury, survey found subsidence. Back to renting for now. Kenji seemed pretty gutted.
Rory - Halloween party at his on the 31st, fancy dress mandatory. Starts at 9. Mustafa and Kiara going as a pair of something. Need a costume.
Video call with Mustafa. He's in Dubai till May 20, then back to London to start the new role on June 1st. His brother Mohammed is looking after his flat meanwhile. Loves the heat, hates the traffic.
Kiara's sister Ann is applying for teaching jobs up north, has a trial lesson at a school in York on Tuesday at 10:15. Kiara's going with her for moral support. Ask Kiara how it went.
Marisol's mum passed away last month. She's going to Mexico City next week for the memorial, back on the 9th. Should send flowers before she flies.

Bridget mentioned her landlord's selling and she has to be out by 12/1. She's viewing three places Saturday morning from 10. Really stressed. Offered to go with her to the 11 o'clock one. Remind me to ask Carlos if his mate's room is still free.
Quiet day. Did the flat inventory, sent photos to the agent. Gas man coming Thursday between 8 and 12.
Mohammed Rossi, Karim's cousin. Met at the 30th. Studying law at King's, final year. Wants to do human rights. Plays oud.
Karim's girlfriend Lwazi got the job at the BBC! She's been interviewing since spring. Starts after Christmas. They're celebrating with a dinner Thursday at 7:30, I'm invited.
Bao said her parents are coming over from Hanoi for her graduation, July 12, ceremony at 2pm. She's nervous about them meeting her boyfriend Archie for the first time.

Dinner with Ethan, Zainab and Vera last night. Ethan's starting at the new place Monday morning, sounds nervous but excited. Zainab and her husband are flying to Marrakech on the 3rd for their anniversary. Vera's flat sale finally went through after six months, completes April 30. Good night. Message Ethan on Monday evening to ask how day one went.
Matilda's job interview at the museum was Tuesday. She found out this morning she's through to the final round, May 9 at 10am. She'll have to do a presentation. Her mum is driving her in.
Agnieszka and Kenji's wedding is officially off. She's moving out of their place this weekend, staying with her sister for a bit. Really should check on her next week.
Adriana's 30th - thinking a weekend in Paris with the girls, end of March. She loves anything with Frida Kahlo on it, worth remembering for her present.
Mei is applying for the MA in Edinburgh, application due January 15 at 5pm. Her boyfriend Aidan is not keen on long distance. She asked me to read her personal statement. Do that before Sunday.
Marcus Dubois from the climbing gym. Works as a paramedic, does nights. Lives in Walthamstow with his partner Rory and a cat called Nacho.
Note to self - ring the removals company tomorrow at 9 and get a quote for 10/24.

Phone call with Mia, mostly about her move. She viewed a two bed in Clapton on Saturday at noon and put an offer in that evening. Hears back Wednesday. If it goes through she wants to move by October 30 so she can host her birthday there on November 4th. Her girlfriend Zainab is less sure, worried about the commute. Mia also said she's quitting her job at the agency after Christmas to freelance. Help her look at removal quotes this week.
Patrick's daughter Kiara got into Oxford! Starts in October. He's beside himself. Must get her a card.
Rosa got a job offer in Berlin, starts 3/1. She's not sure whether to take it, her mum's not well. Talked it through for an hour. Said I'd call her Sunday afternoon to see what she's decided.
Ann's housewarming was lovely, the garden's massive. Her husband Louis is already planning a veg patch. Should send a thank you text.

Lunch with Carlos and Bridget. Carlos has a trial shift at a Michelin place on Saturday the 18th at 4pm, which is huge for him, he's terrified. Bridget's helping him practise the menu. After that they're off to Cornwall for a week, leaving the 20th. Carlos mentioned Bridget's birthday is November 2nd and she's been eyeing a vintage camera. Text Carlos good luck on Friday.
